motion.name: home-fluid-solver
motion.value: simulation 112; dye 384; long target max 768; pressure 14; pixel ratio max 1.5; display max 2000000 pixels
motion.purpose: Home-only lazy Three GPU solver adapted from MIT Pavel Dobryakov: seeded opening, curl/vorticity/projection, pointer splats and two pigment weights over filler. Replaces the old home atmosphere. Fixed inert/aria-hidden/pointer-transparent canvas; no touch interception/cursor replacement. Hidden tabs pause, teardown disposes, context loss falls back and restoration reinitializes. Reduced motion skips solver entirely; static CSS also covers no WebGL.

motion.name: public-pointer-wave-strength
motion.purpose: Background-only passive non-touch pointer waves. Reduced motion removes waves and freezes field/grain time; hidden tabs stop rendering. Shared BLOOM_DEFAULTS caps pixel ratio at 1.5 and drawing buffer at 2500000 pixels; grain strength .035, size 1 CSS px, speed 1, orb frame 60ms. No added atmosphere on photos/admin/CMS.

narrative.overview:
This is a record of the approved, implemented non-photograph identity: warm geometric titles on near-black grounds, pale reading text, fine rules and quiet authoring controls. Its visual authority is the user-pinned [old Adobe Portfolio](https://arnaudnaudbel.myportfolio.com/), interpreted through approved open-source fonts rather than copied font binaries or reference imagery.

**Scope is binding:** apply this system to `/blog`, journal articles, `/admin`, `/admin/posts`, the editor and private preview. The photograph root and `/photos/[filename]` have an independent palette-driven visual system and are excluded. A Photographs link or the photograph-upload admin subsection does not extend these tokens to public photograph pages.
keyCharacteristics: Black grounds and warm tan titles, with pale text for sustained reading.
Jost display hierarchy and Nunito Sans reading, labels and controls.
Flat, finely ruled surfaces with compact, nearly square controls.
One persistent administration shell with explicit state and private-preview context.

rules.name: Homepage-only precedence — 2026-11-05
rules.body: The approved / redesign is an irregular four-image entrance over genuine cursor-driven fluid: pink and yellow pigments with pastel-blue filler. This supersedes only the older homepage album-art atmosphere, hero/route-index layout and entrance type roles below. home-* tokens take precedence on /; existing public-* tokens/history remain intact for other surfaces. Preserve the current owner-supplied P22 Cezanne Pro face, sharp originals, independent photograph, Journal, video/fashion interiors and monochrome native admin. The existing font web-licence gate is unchanged.

rules.name: Homepage composition and publication scope
rules.body: 24-column/16-row irregular desktop grid with minmax(36px,3.8svh) rows; largest Photography left-centre, small Journal upper-centre, tall Fashion upper-right, wide Video lower-right. At 700px and below: staggered Photography 88%, Journal 57%, Video 78%, Fashion 51% widths and 36px gaps. Original aspect ratios, no equal card shells or shadows. Payload Site settings owns images and three palette roles with drafts/autosaves/versions and explicit atomic Publish. Only published active references authorize native images; existing field/grant/identity boundaries stay. Additive migration prepared, not production-applied; see surfaces/homepage.md for synthetic-only evidence and separate production/real-content/font-licence gates.

rules.name: Site-wide typography exception — 2026-11-05
rules.body: P22 Cezanne Pro, cursive via app/site-font.ts and --font-site supersedes older Jost/Nunito narrative and font-scope rules across public pages, photography, CMS and previews. Regular 400 normal only; font-synthesis:none. Existing sizes and requested weights do not imply supplied bold/italic faces. Local wiring only: owner confirmation of appropriate self-hosted web rights is required before deployment or distributing the asset; see app/fonts/README.md. Earlier 45-check browser evidence is pre-Cezanne, not verification of this change.

rules.name: The Scoped Ground Rule
rules.body: Black and tan belong to the non-photograph shells; never replace photograph-derived backgrounds with this palette.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Carry the display/body pairing through articles, authentication, admin forms and preview; do not substitute a generic CMS face for these surfaces.

dos: **Do** keep these tokens scoped to journal and administration, including private preview.
**Do** retain the approved self-hosted Jost / Nunito Sans pairing and bounded reading measure.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus, wrapping controls and explicit saving/publication/private state.
**Do** use existing media as content only; keep browser fixtures clearly labeled.
donts: **Don't** restyle the public photograph root/detail pages using this document.
**Don't** copy Adobe font binaries, old-site imagery or invent shipping raster assets.
**Don't** replace the approved black ground with the superseded cream CMS treatment.
**Don't** infer production authorization or acceptance from a local visual review.
